title: Case 01: The Last Cup
subtitle: The Daily Bean, 8:15 PM. At 8:47 the lights fail. At 8:49 Daniel Rowan is dead. You have three loops to learn why.

maya.name: Maya Cole
maya.secret: Daniel planned to sell the cafe and dismiss the staff.

omar.name: Omar Hale
omar.secret: He was secretly recording Daniel over a corruption story.

lina.name: Lina Vale
lina.secret: Daniel discovered Lina had diverted company money.

theo.name: Theo Marsh
theo.secret: He borrowed the office spare key earlier that evening.

receipt.name: Altered Receipt
receipt.description: Daniel's usual black coffee was changed to an almond syrup drink at 8:31.

watch.name: Broken Watch
watch.description: The watch stopped at exactly 8:47, matching the blackout.

umbrella.name: Wet Umbrella
umbrella.description: Fresh rainwater and a violet fiber place someone in the rear alley.

thread.name: Violet Thread
thread.description: A violet thread is caught on the rear latch. Lina wears the same fabric.

voicemail.name: Recorded Argument
voicemail.description: Omar's recording catches Daniel telling Lina: 'Tomorrow the auditors see everything.'

breaker.name: Breaker Dust
breaker.description: Fresh graphite dust shows the breaker was deliberately bridged for a timed failure.

ledger.name: Missing Ledger Page
ledger.description: A torn page documents transfers approved by Lina to a shell account.

key.name: Spare Office Key
key.description: Theo returned the spare key before the blackout. His access does not match the murder window.

timeline: 8:15 PM — You enter The Daily Bean.
8:23 PM — Omar begins a secret recording.
8:31 PM — Daniel's drink order is altered.
8:39 PM — Lina leaves her table for the rear corridor.
8:43 PM — Someone accesses the office breaker.
truth: Lina altered Daniel's drink with an ingredient she knew could trigger his severe allergy, then arranged the 8:47 blackout to retrieve the financial ledger during the panic. The rear-latch thread, altered receipt, recorded argument and ledger establish means, opportunity and motive.
